scheme_name: Incentive Assistance to Scheduled Caste Farmers to Increase the Area, Production and Productivity of Sugarcane Farming
other_conditions: Must be engaged in sugarcane cultivation.
Must demonstrate excellent production using high-quality seeds, agricultural inputs, and modern farming practices to qualify for the 10% extra incentive.
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹10,000 per hectare for sowing and an additional 10% extra benefit per metric ton for production above 70 t/ha each year.
